_comment_paths: All paths are relative to the repository root. Put the raw PVOD / DKASC CSVs under data/ before running src.preprocess.common_preprocess.
_comment_datasets: The two datasets used in the paper are 'station01' (PVOD, northern hemisphere) and '23-Calyxodataset' (DKASC, southern hemisphere). Hemisphere is inferred from the 'pvod' / 'dka' group.
_comment_scale_scope: 'full' = fit the Z-score statistics on the whole series before splitting (reproduces the published results). 'train' = fit on the train split only (strict anti-leakage, ~6% smaller scale). Overridable with --scale-scope.

training._comment_seq_len: Fixed input window (96 steps = 24 h at 15-min resolution) for every horizon, as in the paper. This is the value train_upvnet.py uses.
